a.title: Faster outbreak detection and reduced public health risk. (Outcome)

text.tspan: Faster outbreak detection and reduced public health risk.

a.title: Increased accuracy and trust in surveillance data. (Outcome)
Timely protection, early alerts, outbreak prevention. Timely public health information, transaparent communication about health risks and protective measures. (Value)
Streamlined reporting tools, reduced manual burden. (Value)
Streamlined case reporting and clinical guidance, compliance with reporting mandates, trusted feedback loops. (Value)
Reliable data streams, real-time situational awareness. (Value)
Interoperable cross-border surveillance data. Standardized surveillance data and reporting that supports global health security and international disease monitoring efforts. (Value)
Integrated diagnostic data sharing, access to surveillance systems that enhance diagnostic accuracy and speed public health response (Value)
Access to de-identified surveillance data for epidemiological research, public health studies, and evidence-based policy development (Value)
Early warning intelligence and coordinated response protocols that enable rapid mobilization of emergency resources and containment measures (Value)

g.text: Colour: which part of the architecture a box belongs to
Why: who cares (stakeholders), and the drivers, goals, outcomes, values and requirements
Shape: what kind of thing a box is (its small italic label names the exact kind)
Cut corners: a reason or aim, such as a stakeholder, goal, outcome or value
Grey band: a grouping for layout only; it adds no meaning
Line: how two boxes are related, read from where the line starts to where it ends
Composition: is made up of (the end is a part that cannot exist without the start)
Association: is related to (no more specific meaning)
